# Crates

Generated by `inference-docs` from `cargo metadata --no-deps`: every package of the workspace, with the `description` its `Cargo.toml` gives. There are 24 packages, all at version `0.8.1`. None is published to a registry; depend on them by Git tag, as [Getting started](../getting-started.md#use-it-in-your-project) shows. A hosted or native adapter does nothing until you turn on its feature. A library is used in Rust under its name with underscores, `inference-stt` as `inference_stt`, unless its row says otherwise.

## Libraries

The contracts, the graph and its runtime, and the optional session API. Each works on its own; a library that needs no adapter links none.

| Package | Features | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| [`inference-audio`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/crates/inference-audio) | none | Audio vocabulary of the inference framework: frames, formats and sample clock positions. |
| [`inference-core`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/crates/inference-core) | none | Shared vocabulary of the inference framework: model and adapter declarations and the shared identifiers. |
| [`inference-duplex`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/crates/inference-duplex) | none | Native speech contract of the inference framework: a session over one speech-to-speech model taking audio and control in and giving audio, transcripts and tool calls out on typed responses. |
| [`inference-facade`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/crates/inference-facade) | `cost` | The optional session API of the inference framework: an application-level interaction lifetime above graph runs, opened over a planned pipeline, driving its run through the pipeline's exposures and delivering one session event vocabulary. |
| [`inference-llm`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/crates/inference-llm) | `tools` | LLM contract of the inference framework: generations over the llm Model contract, streamed as committed segments of the graph, with input offered while they run. |
| [`inference-pipeline`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/crates/inference-pipeline) | none | Pipeline graphs of the inference framework: nodes with typed ports, bounded edges and adapter bindings, declared by command, through a typed builder or from a JSON definition checked against node descriptors. |
| [`inference-runtime`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/crates/inference-runtime) | none | Graph execution of the inference framework: the bounded queue of one edge, with the overload policy its declaration carries, the run and node instance state machines of a planned pipeline, and the controller that drives its nodes. |
| [`inference-stt`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/crates/inference-stt) | none | STT contract of the inference framework: recognisers turning audio frames into hypotheses, revisions and committed spans, with incremental input and output streaming declared apart. |
| [`inference-text`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/crates/inference-text) | none | Text vocabulary of the inference framework: inbound turns and spans from hypothesis to committed text, and outbound output segments from tentative delta to played audio. |
| [`inference-tools`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/crates/inference-tools) | none | Tool vocabulary of the inference framework: tools and their side-effect classes, the tool-call lifecycle from proposal to result, and the executor contract. |
| [`inference-tts`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/crates/inference-tts) | none | TTS contract of the inference framework: synthesisers turning committed output segments into audio frames, with incremental input and output streaming declared apart. |

## Adapters

One package per provider or backend. Which capabilities each claims, and what it measured, is in [Adapters](./adapters.md).

| Package | Features | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| [`inference-audio-device`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/adapters/inference-audio-device) | `device` (default), `pipeline` | Microphone capture and speaker playout for the inference framework: audio devices as frame sources and sinks, over cpal. |
| [`inference-aws`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/adapters/inference-aws) | `duplex`, `live` | Hosted adapter of the inference framework for Amazon Bedrock: an Amazon Nova Sonic speech-to-speech client over the bidirectional stream. |
| [`inference-llama-server`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/adapters/inference-llama-server) | `live`, `tools` | Local adapter of the inference framework for a llama.cpp llama-server: an output-streaming text generator over the llm Chat Completions client. |
| [`inference-openai`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/adapters/inference-openai) | `duplex`, `gpt-live`, `keychain`, `live`, `native-keychain` | OpenAI Realtime and GPT-Live clients for the inference framework: WebSocket sessions with typed client and server events. |
| [`inference-sherpa-onnx`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/adapters/inference-sherpa-onnx) | `stt` | Local adapters of the inference framework over the sherpa-onnx runtime: a streaming speech recogniser behind feature stt. |
| [`inference-whispercpp`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/adapters/inference-whispercpp) | none | Local adapter of the inference framework over whisper.cpp: a batch speech recogniser over one pinned ggml checkpoint. |

## Examples

Runnable programs (`publish = false`); [Examples](../examples/index.md) says what each needs.

| Package | Features | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| [`local-voice-cascade`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/examples/local-voice-cascade) | `local` | Example: the local voice cascade, STT, LLM and TTS through commit gates to a speaker that acknowledges playback, on the testkit mocks or the local adapters, its recogniser sherpa-onnx or whisper.cpp by configuration, and an audio host. |
| [`realtime-voice`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/examples/realtime-voice) | none | Example: a spoken conversation with a native speech model, microphone in and speaker out, with barge-in and one demo tool. |
| [`repo-podcast`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/examples/repo-podcast) | none | Example: Claude distils a repository into a brief, and two voice models discuss it as a podcast over the speaker, in a terminal UI. |
| [`stt-only`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/examples/stt-only) | none | Example: speech recognition alone, against the STT contract and the mock recogniser. |
| [`stt-sherpa-onnx`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/examples/stt-sherpa-onnx) | none | Example: speech recognition alone, against the STT contract and the local sherpa-onnx recogniser. |

## Test kit and tooling

The in-memory stores and conformance target the tests use, and this site's generator (`publish = false`). Nothing outside the repository depends on them.

| Package | Features | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| [`inference-docs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/crates/inference-docs) | none | Binary `inference-docs`. Generates the derived pages and data of the inference documentation site (crate list, adapter claims, error kinds, status, landing terminal) and checks them for drift. |
| [`inference-testkit`](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/tree/main/crates/inference-testkit) | `duplex`, `llm`, `run`, `stt`, `tts` | Test utilities of the inference framework: in-memory stores per domain and, behind features, the run stores and the mocks of the contracts. |
